verdict.rationale: Exporting your own records from an online government tax account is a reasonable thing to ask of a tax agency's digital services, so the axis applies even though 'leaving' a tax authority is not a real option. The evidence pack documents registration, filing, payments, document submission and EFILE transmission-history viewing, but nothing about bulk export of a user's data in open formats. Viewing transmission history is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
